---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
Describe the problem this feature would solve. Ex. "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Use Case
Describe a concrete use case where this feature would be helpful.

## Example API
If applicable, show what the API might look like:
```cpp
// Example usage of the proposed feature
CollisionChecker checker(0.5);
checker.addPolygonObstacle(vertices);  // New feature
```

## Implementation Notes
Any thoughts on how this could be implemented?

## Related Work
Link to similar features in other libraries or papers.

## Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - blocking my work
- [ ] High - would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] Medium - nice to have
- [ ] Low - just an idea

## Willing to Contribute?
- [ ] I'm willing to implement this feature
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can help with documentation
- [ ] I can provide code review
